## Use 0xProto in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set 0xProto for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'0xProto', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace",
  "editor.fontLigatures": true
}

## About the 0xProto coding font

A high-legibility programming font whose ligatures preserve the original symbol shapes. 0xProto is a free monospace coding font with programming ligatures.

0xProto is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## 0xProto FAQ

### Is 0xProto free?

Yes. 0xProto is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does 0xProto support ligatures?

Yes. 0xProto ships programming ligatures. Use the ligature switch above the specimen, or set "editor.fontLigatures": true in VS Code.

### Where can I get 0xProto?

0xProto is available from GitHub. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
